=== owners.POST.yml ===
composition:
  authorize: "hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')"

# A repeated create carrying an already-seen Idempotency-Key replays the originally
# created owner (200) rather than creating a duplicate. First seen (or no key): proceed
# to build. This runs first so the replay short-circuits before the duplicate check. It
# only reads an in-memory token store and branches, so it needs no transaction.
checkIdempotency:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckIdempotencyKey
  outputs:
    proceed: build
    replay: replayLoad

# Replay branch: load and respond with the remembered owner (200), mirroring GET. A read,
# so readonly-transaction; reuses the shared RespondWithOwner responder.
replayLoad:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.LoadReplayedOwner
  govern: [ readonly-transaction ]
  next: replayRespond
replayRespond:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RespondWithOwner
  govern: [ readonly-transaction ]

build:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.BuildOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: validatePostcode

# Validate the postcode (when present) against the city's region before any
# persistence work, so an out-of-range postcode is a 400.
validatePostcode:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidatePostcode
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: normalizeEmail

normalizeEmail:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.NormalizeOwnerEmail
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: normalizeTelephone

normalizeTelephone:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.NormalizeOwnerTelephone
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: rejectDuplicateIdentity

# Hard duplicate detection (409): rejects an owner whose identityKey (SHA-256 over normalized
# telephone, lower-cased email and soundex(lastName)) matches an existing, non-deleted owner's.
# Runs after the email-domain blocklist and telephone normalization so the key is comparable.
rejectDuplicateIdentity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RejectDuplicateIdentity
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: normalizeAddress

normalizeAddress:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.NormalizeOwnerAddress
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: rejectFutureRegistrationDate

# Reject a supplied registrationDate later than the server date (400), before the
# weekend-roll normalization so the check is on the supplied date.
rejectFutureRegistrationDate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RejectFutureRegistrationDate
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: normalizeRegistrationDate

normalizeRegistrationDate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.NormalizeOwnerRegistrationDate
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignHousehold

# Store the deterministic householdId (hash of last name + postcode) on the owner, for
# OwnerIdentity and the DTO. The duplicate check and household-size count below derive the
# household themselves, so they do not read this stored value.
assignHousehold:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignHousehold
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: rejectCityAtCapacity

rejectCityAtCapacity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RejectCityAtCapacity
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: flagCityCapacityWarning

# Soft capacity signal: sets capacityWarning when the city already holds 40-49 owners
# (approaching the hard limit of 50). Runs after the hard reject above, so the count is
# at most 49 here; flags, never rejects.
flagCityCapacityWarning:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.FlagCityCapacityWarning
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: rejectOverDailyLimit

rejectOverDailyLimit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RejectOverDailyLimit
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: countHouseholdMembers

countHouseholdMembers:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CountHouseholdMembers
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignMemberId

assignMemberId:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignOwnerMemberId
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: countNamesakes

countNamesakes:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CountOwnerNamesakes
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: flagBulkSignup

flagBulkSignup:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.FlagBulkSignup
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignMembershipLevel

assignMembershipLevel:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignMembershipLevel
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: capMembershipLevel

# Cap the derived level to at most one above the current maximum membershipLevel among
# the owner's existing household members. No existing household member => no cap.
capMembershipLevel:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CapMembershipLevel
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: flagPossibleDuplicate

# Soft duplicate signal: shares an existing owner's lastName and postcode with a different
# telephone. Flags, never rejects; skipped for a declared household member (sharesHousehold).
flagPossibleDuplicate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.FlagPossibleDuplicate
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: save

save:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.SaveOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: recordIdempotency

# Remember this owner under the request's Idempotency-Key (when present) so a repeat
# create replays it. After save so the owner has its id; no-op when no key was supplied.
recordIdempotency:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RecordIdempotencyKey
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: audit

audit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AuditOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: enqueueWelcome

# On successful create, enqueue a welcome notification: emit via the NOTIFY logger a
# line carrying the owner id and memberId. After save so the owner has its id.
enqueueWelcome:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnqueueWelcomeNotification
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: respond

respond:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RespondWithOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]

## OfficeFloor REST endpoints

Applies when adding or changing REST endpoints. This project serves REST through
OfficeFloor Function Injection, **not** Spring MVC controllers: each endpoint is a
pipeline of small function classes wired together in YAML.

- Requires the OfficeFloor Spring Boot starter in the build:
  `officefloor-rest-spring-boot-4-starter` (Spring Boot 4.x) or
  `officefloor-rest-spring-boot-3-starter` (Spring Boot 3.x). Without it these YAML
  files are inert. (Rules below track these starter versions.)
- Define each endpoint as a YAML file under `src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/`,
  named `<path>.<METHOD>.yml` (e.g. `owners/{ownerId}.PUT.yml` → `PUT /owners/{ownerId}`).
- One small function class per step; compose steps with `next:` and `outputs:`.
- Do NOT generate `@RestController`, `@GetMapping` or `@PostMapping`.
- Transactions: `govern: [ transaction ]` on steps, not `@Transactional`.
- Errors: a handler YAML in `officefloor/escalation/`, not `@ControllerAdvice`.

### Worked example — `PUT /owners/{ownerId}`

The whole shape of an endpoint. The sections after this one are the reference.

`src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/owners/{ownerId}.PUT.yml`

```yaml
# First step runs first. Validate before Load so an invalid body is a 400,
# not masked by a 404 for a missing owner.
validate:
  class: com.example.owner.ValidateOwner
  next: load
load:
  class: com.example.owner.LoadOwner
  next: apply
apply:
  class: com.example.owner.ApplyOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: save
save:
  class: com.example.owner.SaveOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: respond

## Summary

This is a Spring PetClinic REST app where request handling is OfficeFloor function injection. Owner-identity derivation lives in `src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/`. The owner response DTO (`OwnerDto`) is **generated at build time** from `src/main/resources/openapi.yml` (OpenAPI generator, `modelNameSuffix=Dto`) — there is no hand-written `OwnerDto.java`, so response-shape changes (adding `apiVersion`, nesting an `identity` object) must be made in `openapi.yml` plus `OwnerMapper`. An acceptance test (`AcceptanceTest`) already encodes the V2 target contract but the production code does not yet satisfy it.

---

## 1. Identifier derivation (householdId, identityKey, memberId, region code)

### `OwnerIdentity.java` — identityKey
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/OwnerIdentity.java`
- `identityKey(Owner)` (line 30): full SHA-256 hex over `normalizedTelephone + "|" + lowerEmail + "|" + Soundex.of(lastName)`.
```java
public static String identityKey(Owner owner) {
    String canonical = normalizedTelephone(owner) + "|" + lowerEmail(owner) + "|" + Soundex.of(owner.getLastName());
    return Hashing.sha256Hex(canonical);
}
```
- Helpers `normalizedTelephone` (line 39, E.164 via `OwnerTelephones.toE164`), `lowerEmail` (line 48).
- Note: the class Javadoc and the `openapi.yml` description of `identityKey` (`<normalizedTelephone>|<email>|<householdId>`) are **stale/inconsistent** with the actual code (which uses `soundex(lastName)` and then hashes).

### `HouseholdKey.java` — householdId
`/home/daniel/sandbox/.../owner/HouseholdKey.java`
- `of(Owner)` (line 31), `canonical()` = `lastName + "|" + postcode` (line 41), `normalize()` lower/trim/collapse (line 76).
- `householdId()` (line 50):
```java
String householdId() {
    return Hashing.sha256HexPrefix(canonical(), 6);
}
```
Note: Javadoc says "first 12 hex characters" and `sha256HexPrefix(..., 6)` produces exactly 6 bytes = 12 hex chars.

### `AssignOwnerMemberId.java` — memberId `<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>`
`/home/daniel/sandbox/.../owner/AssignOwnerMemberId.java`
- `service(...)` (line 31):
```java
String region = OwnerRegion.regionOf(owner);
String fy = String.format("%02d", OwnerFiscalYear.fiscalYearOf(owner.getRegistrationDate()) % 100);
String hash8 = sha256Hex8(owner.getTelephone() + owner.getLastName());
String withoutCheck = region + fy + hash8;
String base = withoutCheck + luhnCheckDigit(withoutCheck);
```
- Collision handling appends `-<n>` (line 50-53).
- `sha256Hex8` = first 8 **upper-case** hex chars (line 58); `luhnCheckDigit` (line 74). This is a **separate** hashing implementation from `Hashing.java` (upper-case, inline MessageDigest) — relevant for a V2 bump.

### `Hashing.java` — shared SHA-256 helper
`/home/daniel/sandbox/.../owner/Hashing.java`
- `sha256Hex` (line 18, 64-char lower hex), `sha256HexPrefix(value, bytes)` (line 23). Used by `OwnerIdentity` and `HouseholdKey` (but NOT by `AssignOwnerMemberId`, which has its own `sha256Hex8`).

### `Soundex.java`
`/home/daniel/sandbox/.../owner/Soundex.java` — `of(String)` (line 19). Feeds both `OwnerIdentity` and `FlagPossibleDuplicate`.

---

## 2. Locality, timezone, region / owner-segment derivation

### `OwnerRegion.java` — region code + timezone
`/home/daniel/sandbox/.../owner/OwnerRegion.java`
- Tables: `CITY_REGION` (line 23), `REGION_POSTCODES` (line 27), `REGION_TIMEZONE` (line 33).
- `isKnownRegion` (line 39), `timezoneOfRegion` (line 44).
- `regionOf(Owner)` (line 49): postcode 4-digit range match, else city table, else `"UNKNOWN"`.
- `regionFromMemberId(String)` (line 74): strips the fixed trailing suffix `MEMBER_ID_SUFFIX_LENGTH = 11` (line 65, = 2 FY + 8 HASH + 1 CHK) and any `-<n>` collision suffix to recover the REGION segment. **This 11 is hard-coded to the V1 memberId layout** — a V2 layout change (e.g. a `V2` tag inside the memberId) would break this extraction.

### `OwnerMapper.java` — locality, timezone, ownerSegment (DTO derivation)
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/OwnerMapper.java`
- `locality(owner)` (line 138): `OwnerRegion.regionFromMemberId(memberId)`, falling back to `regionOf(owner)`.
- `timezone(owner)` (line 150): `OwnerRegion.timezoneOfRegion(locality(owner))`.
- `ownerSegment(owner)` (line 52): `<TIER>_<AREA>` where TIER=PREMIUM when `membershipLevel>=3`, AREA=METRO when `isKnownRegion(locality(owner))`. Returns `OwnerDto.OwnerSegmentEnum` (generated enum).
- The `@Mapping` annotations wiring these onto the DTO are lines 21-43 (`identityKey` line 40-41, `ownerSegment` line 42, `locality` line 27, `timezone` line 28). This interface is the central response-assembly point.

---

## 3. Audit event with schema version concept

### `AuditOwnerCreated.java`
`/home/daniel/sandbox/.../owner/AuditOwnerCreated.java`
- `service(Owner)` (line 23): logs human line, then serializes `OwnerCreatedEvent` to JSON on the `"AUDIT"` logger (line 30). `SEQUENCE` monotonic (line 21), Jackson `MAPPER` (line 18).
- `primaryIdentifier(owner)` (line 38) returns `owner.getMemberId()`.

### `OwnerCreatedEvent.java`
`/home/daniel/sandbox/.../owner/OwnerCreatedEvent.java`
- Record `OwnerCreatedEvent(long seq, Integer ownerId, String memberId, Integer membershipLevel, String event)` (line 17).
- Convenience constructor stamps `event = "OWNER_CREATED"` (line 24).
- **There is currently NO `schemaVersion` field** — this record is where a schema-version concept would be added. The only "version"-like constant today is the `OWNER_CREATED` event discriminator (line 21).

---

## 4. Owner response shape (DTO / serialization)

- **No hand-written DTO.** `OwnerDto` is generated by the `openapi-generator-maven-plugin` from `openapi.yml` into `target/generated-sources/openapi/.../rest/dto/OwnerDto.java` (`pom.xml` lines 370-411, `modelPackage=...rest.dto`, `modelNameSuffix=Dto`).
- Schema: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/openapi.yml`, `Owner:` at **line 2134** (allOf extending `OwnerFields`). Relevant flat top-level properties today:
  - `memberId` (line 2186), `fiscalYear` (2201), `householdId` (2211), `identityKey` (2221), `locality` (2298), `timezone` (2308), `ownerSegment` (2370, enum), `selfLink` (2386), plus `displayName/salutation/initials/telephoneDisplay/...`.
  - **No `apiVersion` property and no nested `identity` object exist yet.** For V2 these three (`memberId`, `identityKey`, `householdId`) must move under a new nested `identity` object and a new top-level `apiVersion: 2` added — in `openapi.yml` and correspondingly in `OwnerMapper`.
- Response assembly functions:
  - `RespondWithOwner.java` (line 11): `response.send(ownerMapper.toOwnerDto(owner))` — used by `GET /api/owners/{id}` and idempotent replay.
  - `RespondWithOwnerCreated.java` (line 14): builds `201 Created` with `toOwnerDto(owner)`.
- Owner entity persisted fields (`memberId`, `householdId`, etc.): `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Owner.java` — `memberId` line 73, `householdId` line 76, getters/setters lines 189-203.

---

## 5. Existing tests covering these

### `AcceptanceTest.java` — **the V2 target contract (already written)**
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AcceptanceTest.java`
```java
/** identity-v2: apiVersion is 2, the memberId/identityKey/householdId are grouped under a nested
 * 'identity' object, and those three are no longer at the top level. Exact structural contract. */
...
void coreV2GroupsIdentityAndVersions() throws Exception {
    int id = createOwnerOk(structuredOwner());
    getOwner(id).andExpect(jsonPath("$.apiVersion").value(2))
            .andExpect(jsonPath("$.identity.memberId").isNotEmpty())
            .andExpect(jsonPath("$.identity.identityKey").isNotEmpty())
            .andExpect(jsonPath("$.identity.householdId").isNotEmpty())
            .andExpect(jsonPath("$.memberId").doesNotExist())
            .andExpect(jsonPath("$.identityKey").doesNotExist())
            .andExpect(jsonPath("$.householdId").doesNotExist());
}
```
This currently will NOT pass against the present flat DTO — it defines the behavior the V2 change must produce.

### `AcceptanceBase.java` — shared black-box harness + replicated derivation ground truth
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AcceptanceBase.java`
- Spring MockMvc black-box base; `@SpringBootTest @AutoConfigureMockMvc @Transactional @WithMockUser(...)` (lines 47-51).
- Payload builders: `ownerNode()` (117), `withPostcode` (129), `structuredOwner()` (136), `knownOwner` (260).
- **Pinned reference tables that duplicate the production algorithm** (must stay in sync on a V2 bump): `CITY_REGION` (line 228), `REGION_TIMEZONE` (232), `REGION_POSTCODES` (236), `HOLIDAYS` (240).
- Replicated derivation helpers: `sha256hex` (282), `shaHex(s, n)` upper-case prefix (297), `luhn` (302), `region`/`timezone`/`validPostcode` (244-256), `toBusinessDay` (268). A V2 algorithm mixing a `'V2'` tag would require updating these helpers to compute the expected values.

### `AuditLogCapture.java` — audit assertion utility
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AuditLogCapture.java`
- Captures the `"AUDIT"` logger via Logback `ListAppender` (lines 25-39); `anyContains` (45), `anyAtLevel` (57). This is how audit-event/schemaVersion assertions would be made.

These three files are the only tests under `src/test`. There are no other unit tests for `OwnerIdentity`, `HouseholdKey`, `OwnerRegion`, or `OwnerCreatedEvent`.

---

## How tests are run (build tool + command)

- **Build tool:** Maven via the wrapper `/home/daniel/sandbox/mvnw` (`mvnw.cmd` on Windows). Parent `spring-boot-starter-parent`; artifact `spring-petclinic-rest` (`pom.xml` line 7).
- **Test command:** standard Surefire — `./mvnw test` (or `./mvnw verify` / `./mvnw clean install`; readme line 218 shows `mvn clean install`). No custom Surefire/Failsafe config; the only `<skip>true</skip>` in `pom.xml` (line 226) belongs to the `apache-rat-plugin`, not to tests.
- **Codegen dependency:** `./mvnw test` triggers `generate-sources`, which runs the OpenAPI generator (pom lines 370-411) to produce `OwnerDto` and the API interfaces into `target/generated-sources/openapi/src/main/java` (added as a source root by build-helper, pom lines 412-429), then MapStruct annotation processing wires `OwnerMapperImpl`. So editing `openapi.yml` is sufficient to change the generated DTO on the next build.

---

## Everything that must change for a "V2" algorithm mixing in a `'V2'` tag

1. `OwnerIdentity.identityKey` (canonical string / hashing) — `OwnerIdentity.java:30`.
2. `HouseholdKey.canonical()` / `householdId()` — `HouseholdKey.java:41,50`.
3. `AssignOwnerMemberId.service` memberId layout + its private `sha256Hex8`/`luhnCheckDigit`; and the collision suffix — `AssignOwnerMemberId.java:31`.
4. `OwnerRegion.regionFromMemberId` / `MEMBER_ID_SUFFIX_LENGTH` (hard-coded to V1 layout) — `OwnerRegion.java:65,74`.
5. `OwnerCreatedEvent` (add `schemaVersion`) + `AuditOwnerCreated` construction — `OwnerCreatedEvent.java:17`, `AuditOwnerCreated.java:28`.
6. Response shape: `openapi.yml` `Owner` schema (add `apiVersion`, nested `identity` object; move `memberId`/`identityKey`/`householdId`) — `openapi.yml:2134+`; and the `@Mapping`s / nested-object assembly in `OwnerMapper.java:21-59`.
7. Test ground truth: `AcceptanceBase.java` replicated hashing/region/luhn helpers and pinned tables; `AcceptanceTest.java` already asserts the V2 structure.

One inconsistency to flag: the `identityKey` description in both `OwnerIdentity`'s Javadoc/`openapi.yml` (`<telephone>|<email>|<householdId>`) does **not** match the actual implementation (`telephone|email|soundex(lastName)` then SHA-256). Verify intended V2 semantics against code, not the docs.

    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the
                stored names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation composed from the optional title and the
                last name: '<title> <lastName>' when a title is present, or just
                the last name when no title was supplied. Derived from the
                owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The owner's initials as the upper-cased first letters of
                firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone (display)
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the country
                code (with its leading '+'), a space, then the national digits
                grouped in threes (e.g. '+61412345678' becomes
                '+61 412 345 678'). Derived from the owner's own telephone; the
                raw 'telephone' field stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: >-
                The owner's unified member id formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>'
                where REGION is the region code derived from the postcode, FY is the
                two-digit fiscal year of the (business-day-adjusted) registrationDate
                (the fiscal year starts on 1 July and is named by the calendar year in
                which it ends, so a date from 1 July 2025 to 30 June 2026 yields '26'),
                HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the
                normalized telephone concatenated with the lastName, and CHK is a single
                Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'.
                Assigned on create (e.g. 'NSW261A2B3C4D7').
              type: string
              example: 'NSW261A2B3C4D7'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the owner's (business-day-adjusted) registrationDate,
                formatted 'FY<YY>'. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and is named by the
                calendar year in which it ends, so a date from 1 July 2025 to 30 June
                2026 yields 'FY26'. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A deterministic identifier shared by owners of the same household:
                the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized last name
                and postcode. Assigned to every owner on create, so owners with the
                same last name and postcode return the same value automatically.
              type: string
              example: '3f9a2c1b8d4e'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key, formatted
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<email-or-empty>|<householdId-or-empty>'
                where the telephone is the stored E.164 value, the email is the
                stored lower-cased address (empty when absent) and the household
                id is the stored value (empty when absent). A derived field returned
                on the owner; duplicate detection itself is keyed on the household
                (last name and postcode). Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners (before this owner was created) that
                shared the same firstName and lastName, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, fixed on creation. Starts at 0, adds 2
                when an email address is present, adds 1 when namesakeCount is 0, adds 2
                for a household of three or more members and adds 3 for tenure over one
                elapsed fiscal year. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, fixed on creation and derived from
                membershipPoints: level 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3 points, 3 for 4-5
                points and 4 for 6 or more points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner, though not a hard (identityKey) duplicate, was
                created while sharing an existing owner's lastName and postcode with a
                different telephone; false otherwise. Assigned on create.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner possibly duplicates (shared
                lastName and postcode, different telephone); the lowest-id match when
                several exist. Present only when possibleDuplicate is true.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is
                false; DELETE /api/owners/{id} flags it true while retaining the
                record, so the owner is still returned by GET but is ignored by the
                create endpoint's duplicate/identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality (region) taken from the REGION segment of the
                memberId identity ('<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>'), i.e. the region derived
                from the postcode (city-to-region table as fallback: Sydney->NSW,
                Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD). 'UNKNOWN' when no region resolves.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone name derived from the locality/region via
                the pinned region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the
                region has no mapped timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created on this
                owner's (business-day-adjusted) registration date at the time this
                owner was created, otherwise false. Assigned on create.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when the owner's city already held between 40 and 49 owners
                (inclusive) at the time this owner was created, signalling the city
                is approaching the hard capacity limit of 50; otherwise false.
                Assigned on create.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                True when the owner should be flagged for risk review: set when the
                owner is a possible duplicate, or the email domain is disposable-adjacent
                (shares a known throwaway provider's base name under a different TLD or as
                a subdomain), or the city is over its soft capacity (the capacity-warning
                threshold); otherwise false. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the owner's
                own fields: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise
                'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from the birthDate against the
                registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64,
                'SENIOR' at 65 or over. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is 'PREMIUM'
                when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is
                'METRO' when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD),
                otherwise 'REGIONAL'. One of 'PREMIUM_METRO', 'PREMIUM_REGIONAL',
                'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical API path to this owner, formatted '/api/owners/<id>'.
                Derived from the owner's own id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content

/** * Single source of truth for an owner's {@code REGION} code — the geographic segment of * the owner's {@code memberId} identity ({@code }) and, through * it, the owner's locality. * *

The plain region is derived from the postcode first: a 4-digit postcode * falling within a known region's inclusive range yields that region. When the postcode is * absent or in no known range, it falls back to the {@link #CITY_REGION} table, returning * {@code UNKNOWN} when the city is not listed. components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            Optional honorific title of the pet owner. When present it is one of
            MR, MRS, MS or DR. It is stored and returned, and the owner's
            salutation is composed from it with the last name.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: 'DR'
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            First line of the owner's structured postal address (street number and
            name). Preferred over the flat 'address' field when present; when present
            it must be non-blank. Normalized on create (trimmed, whitespace collapsed,
            upper-cased, common street-type abbreviations expanded) and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            Optional second line of the structured postal address (unit, suite, etc.).
            Normalized on create the same way as addressLine1 and, when present,
            appended to the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 5'
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted as a flat value for backward
            compatibility when the structured 'addressLine1' is not supplied. On create
            it is the composed, normalized address: equal to the normalized addressLine1
            with the normalized addressLine2 appended after a single space when present,
            or the normalized flat value when only the flat form was supplied. An owner
            must supply an address in either form (a non-blank addressLine1, or this
            flat field) plus a city.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            Optional 4-digit postcode. When present it must be a 4-digit value and,
            for a city with a known region (Sydney=NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne=VIC
            3000-3099, Brisbane=QLD 4000-4099), fall within that region's inclusive
            range; a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. It is
            stored and returned.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61' is
            assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits;
            there must be 8 to 15 digits after the '+'. The E.164 value is stored
            and returned (e.g. '0412 345 678' becomes '+61412345678').
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            Optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current
            date. It is stored and returned.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Create-time flag. The householdId is always deterministic from (last name,
            postcode), so this flag no longer creates the link. It only bypasses the
            duplicate block: a second owner in an existing household is rejected with 409
            unless it sets sharesHousehold true, in which case it is created as a declared
            household member and is not flagged as a possible duplicate. Not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: false
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            Optional date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. When
            present it is stored and returned, and the owner's ageBand is derived from
            it against the registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the
                stored names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation composed from the optional title and the
                last name: '<title> <lastName>' when a title is present, or just
                the last name when no title was supplied. Derived from the
                owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The owner's initials as the upper-cased first letters of
                firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone (display)
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the country
                code (with its leading '+'), a space, then the national digits
                grouped in threes (e.g. '+61412345678' becomes
                '+61 412 345 678'). Derived from the owner's own telephone; the
                raw 'telephone' field stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: >-
                The owner's unified member id formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>'
                where REGION is the region code derived from the postcode, FY is the
                two-digit fiscal year of the (business-day-adjusted) registrationDate
                (the fiscal year starts on 1 July and is named by the calendar year in
                which it ends, so a date from 1 July 2025 to 30 June 2026 yields '26'),
                HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the
                normalized telephone concatenated with the lastName, and CHK is a single
                Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'.
                Assigned on create (e.g. 'NSW261A2B3C4D7').
              type: string
              example: 'NSW261A2B3C4D7'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the owner's (business-day-adjusted) registrationDate,
                formatted 'FY<YY>'. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and is named by the
                calendar year in which it ends, so a date from 1 July 2025 to 30 June
                2026 yields 'FY26'. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A deterministic identifier shared by owners of the same household:
                the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized last name
                and postcode. Assigned to every owner on create, so owners with the
                same last name and postcode return the same value automatically.
              type: string
              example: '3f9a2c1b8d4e'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key, formatted
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<email-or-empty>|<householdId-or-empty>'
                where the telephone is the stored E.164 value, the email is the
                stored lower-cased address (empty when absent) and the household
                id is the stored value (empty when absent). A derived field returned
                on the owner; duplicate detection itself is keyed on the household
                (last name and postcode). Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners (before this owner was created) that
                shared the same firstName and lastName, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, fixed on creation. Starts at 0, adds 2
                when an email address is present, adds 1 when namesakeCount is 0, adds 2
                for a household of three or more members and adds 3 for tenure over one
                elapsed fiscal year. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, fixed on creation and derived from
                membershipPoints: level 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3 points, 3 for 4-5
                points and 4 for 6 or more points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner, though not a hard (identityKey) duplicate, was
                created while sharing an existing owner's lastName and postcode with a
                different telephone; false otherwise. Assigned on create.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner possibly duplicates (shared
                lastName and postcode, different telephone); the lowest-id match when
                several exist. Present only when possibleDuplicate is true.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is
                false; DELETE /api/owners/{id} flags it true while retaining the
                record, so the owner is still returned by GET but is ignored by the
                create endpoint's duplicate/identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality (region) taken from the REGION segment of the
                memberId identity ('<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>'), i.e. the region derived
                from the postcode (city-to-region table as fallback: Sydney->NSW,
                Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD). 'UNKNOWN' when no region resolves.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone name derived from the locality/region via
                the pinned region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the
                region has no mapped timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created on this
                owner's (business-day-adjusted) registration date at the time this
                owner was created, otherwise false. Assigned on create.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when the owner's city already held between 40 and 49 owners
                (inclusive) at the time this owner was created, signalling the city
                is approaching the hard capacity limit of 50; otherwise false.
                Assigned on create.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                True when the owner should be flagged for risk review: set when the
                owner is a possible duplicate, or the email domain is disposable-adjacent
                (shares a known throwaway provider's base name under a different TLD or as
                a subdomain), or the city is over its soft capacity (the capacity-warning
                threshold); otherwise false. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the owner's
                own fields: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise
                'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from the birthDate against the
                registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64,
                'SENIOR' at 65 or over. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is 'PREMIUM'
                when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is
                'METRO' when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD),
                otherwise 'REGIONAL'. One of 'PREMIUM_METRO', 'PREMIUM_REGIONAL',
                'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical API path to this owner, formatted '/api/owners/<id>'.
                Derived from the owner's own id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        page:
          title: Page
          description: Zero-based page index.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 0
        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 1
          example: 5
        totalElements:
          title: Total elements
          description: Total number of owners matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0
          example: 10
        totalPages:
          title: Total pages
          description: Total number of pages matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 2
      required:
        - content
        - page
        - size
        - totalElements
        - totalPages
    PetPage:
      title: Pet page
      description: A page of pets.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pets in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
        page:
          title: Page
          description: Zero-based page index.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 0
        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 1
          example: 5
        totalElements:
          title: Total elements
          description: Total number of pets matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0
          example: 10
        totalPages:
          title: Total pages
          description: Total number of pages matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 2
      required:
        - content
        - page
        - size
        - totalElements
        - totalPages
    PetFields:
      title: Pet fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet.
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the pet.
          type: string
          maxLength: 30
          example: Leo
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The date of birth of the pet.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2010-09-07'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.PetAgeValidation"
        type:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/PetType'
      required:
        - name
        - birthDate
        - type
    Pet:
      title: Pet
      description: A pet.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/PetFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            ownerId:
              title: Owner ID
              description: The ID of the pet's owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            visits:
              title: Visits
              description: Vet visit bookings for this pet.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Visit'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - id
            - type
            - visits
    VetFields:
      title: VetFields
      description: Editable fields of a veterinarian.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the vet.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: 'James'
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the vet.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: 'Carter'
        specialties:
          title: Specialties
          description: The specialties of the vet.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Specialty'
      required:
        - firstName

    Vet:

        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/VetFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the vet.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
      required:
        - id
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - specialties
    VisitFields:
      title: Visit fields
      description: Editable fields of a vet visit.
      type: object
      properties:
        date:
          title: Date
          description: The date of the visit.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2013-01-01'
        description:
          title: Description
          description: The description for the visit.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'rabies shot'
      required:
        - description
    Visit:

      description: A booking for a vet visit.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/VisitFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the visit.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            petId:
              title: Pet ID
              description: The ID of the pet.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
          required:
            - id
            - petId
    PetTypeFields:
      title: PetType fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet type.
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the pet type.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: cat
      required:
        - name
    PetType:
      title: Pet type
      description: A pet type.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/PetTypeFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet type.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
          required:
            - id
    User:
      title: User
      description: An user.
      type: object
      properties:
        username:
          title: username
          description: The username
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: john.doe
        password:
          title: Password
          description: The password
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: 1234abc
        enabled:
          title: enabled
          description: Indicates if the user is enabled
          type: boolean
          example: true
        roles:
          title: Roles
          description: The roles of an user
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Role'
      required:
        - username
    Role:
      title: Role
      description: A role.
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          title: name
          description: The role's name
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: admin
      required:
        - name

openapi: 3.0.1
info:
  title: Spring PetClinic
  description: Spring PetClinic Sample Application.
  license:
    name: Apache 2.0
    url: https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
  version: '1.0'
servers:
  - url: http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api
tags:
  - name: oops
    description: Endpoint which always returns an error.
  - name: owners
    description: Endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: owner-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pet owners.
  - name: users
    description: Endpoints related to users.
  - name: pets
    description: Endpoints related to pets.
  - name: pet-v2
    description: Version 2 endpoints related to pets.
  - name: vets
    description: Endpoints related to vets.
  - name: visits
    description: Endpoints related to vet visits.
  - name: pettypes
    description: Endpoints related to pet types.
  - name: specialties
    description: Endpoints related to vet specialties.
paths:
  /oops:
    get:
      tags:
        - oops
      operationId: failingRequest
      summary: Always fails
      description: Produces sample error response.
      responses:
        200:
          description: Never returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            text/plain:
              schema:
                type: string
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners:
    post:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: addOwner
      summary: Adds a pet owner
      description: Records the details of a new pet owner.
      requestBody:
        description: The pet owner
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        required: true
      responses:
        201:
          description: The pet owner was successfully added.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    get:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: listOwners
      summary: Lists pet owners
      description: Returns an array of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /v2/owners:
    get:
      tags:
        - owner-v2
      operationId: listOwnersPage
      summary: Lists pet owners with pagination
      description: Returns a page of pet owners.
      parameters:
        - name: lastName
          in: query
          description: Last name.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
            example: Davis
        - name: page
          in: query
          description: Zero-based page index.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            default: 0
            example: 0
        - name: size
          in: query
          description: Number of items per page.
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 100
            default: 20
            example: 5
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner page found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerPage'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            Etag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
  /owners/{ownerId}:
    get:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: getOwner
      summary: Get a pet owner by ID
      description: Returns the pet owner or a 404 error.
      parameters:
        - name: ownerId
          in: path
          description: The ID of the pet owner.
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            example: 1
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        304:
          description: Not modified.
          headers:
            ETag:
              description: An ID for this version of the response.
              schema:
                type: string
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        404:
          description: Owner not found.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
    put:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: updateOwner
      summary: Update a pet owner's details
      description: Updates the pet owner record with the specified details.
      parameters:
        - name: ownerId
          in: path
          description: The ID of the pet owner.
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            example: 1
      requestBody:
        description: The pet owner details to use for the update.
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        required: true
      responses:
        200:
          description: Update successful.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        400:
          description: Bad request.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        404:
          description: Owner not found.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'

    delete:
      tags:
        - owners
      operationId: deleteOwner
      summary: Delete an owner by ID
      description: Returns the owner or a 404 error.
      parameters:
        - name: ownerId
          in: path
          description: The ID of the owner.
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
            format: int32
            minimum: 0
            example: 1
      responses:
        200:
          description: Owner details found and returned.
          headers:
