components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            Optional honorific title of the pet owner. When present it is one of
            MR, MRS, MS or DR. It is stored and returned, and the owner's
            salutation is composed from it with the last name.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: 'DR'
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            First line of the owner's structured postal address (street number and
            name). Preferred over the flat 'address' field when present; when present
            it must be non-blank. Normalized on create (trimmed, whitespace collapsed,
            upper-cased, common street-type abbreviations expanded) and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            Optional second line of the structured postal address (unit, suite, etc.).
            Normalized on create the same way as addressLine1 and, when present,
            appended to the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 5'
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted as a flat value for backward
            compatibility when the structured 'addressLine1' is not supplied. On create
            it is the composed, normalized address: equal to the normalized addressLine1
            with the normalized addressLine2 appended after a single space when present,
            or the normalized flat value when only the flat form was supplied. An owner
            must supply an address in either form (a non-blank addressLine1, or this
            flat field) plus a city.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            Optional 4-digit postcode. When present it must be a 4-digit value and,
            for a city with a known region (Sydney=NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne=VIC
            3000-3099, Brisbane=QLD 4000-4099), fall within that region's inclusive
            range; a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. It is
            stored and returned.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61' is
            assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits;
            there must be 8 to 15 digits after the '+'. The E.164 value is stored
            and returned (e.g. '0412 345 678' becomes '+61412345678').
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            Optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current
            date. It is stored and returned.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Create-time flag. The householdId is always deterministic from (last name,
            postcode), so this flag no longer creates the link. It only bypasses the
            duplicate block: a second owner in an existing household is rejected with 409
            unless it sets sharesHousehold true, in which case it is created as a declared
            household member and is not flagged as a possible duplicate. Not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: false
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            Optional date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. When
            present it is stored and returned, and the owner's ageBand is derived from
            it against the registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the
                stored names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation composed from the optional title and the
                last name: '<title> <lastName>' when a title is present, or just
                the last name when no title was supplied. Derived from the
                owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The owner's initials as the upper-cased first letters of
                firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone (display)
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the country
                code (with its leading '+'), a space, then the national digits
                grouped in threes (e.g. '+61412345678' becomes
                '+61 412 345 678'). Derived from the owner's own telephone; the
                raw 'telephone' field stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: >-
                The version of the owner identity contract this representation uses.
                Fixed at 2: the identifiers (memberId, identityKey, householdId) are
                grouped under the 'identity' object and derived with the version-2
                algorithm.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerIdentity'
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the owner's (business-day-adjusted) registrationDate,
                formatted 'FY<YY>'. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and is named by the
                calendar year in which it ends, so a date from 1 July 2025 to 30 June
                2026 yields 'FY26'. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A deterministic identifier shared by owners of the same household:
                the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized last name
                and postcode. Assigned to every owner on create, so owners with the
                same last name and postcode return the same value automatically.
              type: string
              example: '3f9a2c1b8d4e'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key, formatted
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<email-or-empty>|<householdId-or-empty>'
                where the telephone is the stored E.164 value, the email is the
                stored lower-cased address (empty when absent) and the household
                id is the stored value (empty when absent). A derived field returned
                on the owner; duplicate detection itself is keyed on the household
                (last name and postcode). Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners (before this owner was created) that
                shared the same firstName and lastName, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, fixed on creation. Starts at 0, adds 2
                when an email address is present, adds 1 when namesakeCount is 0, adds 2
                for a household of three or more members and adds 3 for tenure over one
                elapsed fiscal year. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, fixed on creation and derived from
                membershipPoints: level 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3 points, 3 for 4-5
                points and 4 for 6 or more points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner, though not a hard (identityKey) duplicate, was
                created while sharing an existing owner's lastName and postcode with a
                different telephone; false otherwise. Assigned on create.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner possibly duplicates (shared
                lastName and postcode, different telephone); the lowest-id match when
                several exist. Present only when possibleDuplicate is true.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is
                false; DELETE /api/owners/{id} flags it true while retaining the
                record, so the owner is still returned by GET but is ignored by the
                create endpoint's duplicate/identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality (region) taken from the REGION segment of the
                memberId identity ('<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>'), i.e. the region derived
                from the postcode (city-to-region table as fallback: Sydney->NSW,
                Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD). 'UNKNOWN' when no region resolves.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone name derived from the locality/region via
                the pinned region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the
                region has no mapped timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created on this
                owner's (business-day-adjusted) registration date at the time this
                owner was created, otherwise false. Assigned on create.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when the owner's city already held between 40 and 49 owners
                (inclusive) at the time this owner was created, signalling the city
                is approaching the hard capacity limit of 50; otherwise false.
                Assigned on create.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                True when the owner should be flagged for risk review: set when the
                owner is a possible duplicate, or the email domain is disposable-adjacent
                (shares a known throwaway provider's base name under a different TLD or as
                a subdomain), or the city is over its soft capacity (the capacity-warning
                threshold); otherwise false. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the owner's
                own fields: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise
                'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from the birthDate against the
                registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64,
                'SENIOR' at 65 or over. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is 'PREMIUM'
                when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is
                'METRO' when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD),
                otherwise 'REGIONAL'. One of 'PREMIUM_METRO', 'PREMIUM_REGIONAL',

lines: -                A deterministic identifier shared by owners of the same household:
-                the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized last name
-                and postcode. Assigned to every owner on create, so owners with the
-                same last name and postcode return the same value automatically.
-                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key, formatted
-                where the telephone is the stored E.164 value, the email is the
-                stored lower-cased address (empty when absent) and the household
-                id is the stored value (empty when absent). A derived field returned
-                on the owner; duplicate detection itself is keyed on the household
-                (last name and postcode). Derived from the owner's own fields.

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            Optional honorific title of the pet owner. When present it is one of
            MR, MRS, MS or DR. It is stored and returned, and the owner's
            salutation is composed from it with the last name.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: 'DR'
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            First line of the owner's structured postal address (street number and
            name). Preferred over the flat 'address' field when present; when present
            it must be non-blank. Normalized on create (trimmed, whitespace collapsed,
            upper-cased, common street-type abbreviations expanded) and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            Optional second line of the structured postal address (unit, suite, etc.).
            Normalized on create the same way as addressLine1 and, when present,
            appended to the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 5'
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted as a flat value for backward
            compatibility when the structured 'addressLine1' is not supplied. On create
            it is the composed, normalized address: equal to the normalized addressLine1
            with the normalized addressLine2 appended after a single space when present,
            or the normalized flat value when only the flat form was supplied. An owner
            must supply an address in either form (a non-blank addressLine1, or this
            flat field) plus a city.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            Optional 4-digit postcode. When present it must be a 4-digit value and,
            for a city with a known region (Sydney=NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne=VIC
            3000-3099, Brisbane=QLD 4000-4099), fall within that region's inclusive
            range; a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. It is
            stored and returned.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61' is
            assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits;
            there must be 8 to 15 digits after the '+'. The E.164 value is stored
            and returned (e.g. '0412 345 678' becomes '+61412345678').
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            Optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current
            date. It is stored and returned.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Create-time flag. The householdId is always deterministic from (last name,
            postcode), so this flag no longer creates the link. It only bypasses the
            duplicate block: a second owner in an existing household is rejected with 409
            unless it sets sharesHousehold true, in which case it is created as a declared
            household member and is not flagged as a possible duplicate. Not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: false
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            Optional date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. When
            present it is stored and returned, and the owner's ageBand is derived from
            it against the registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the
                stored names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation composed from the optional title and the
                last name: '<title> <lastName>' when a title is present, or just
                the last name when no title was supplied. Derived from the
                owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The owner's initials as the upper-cased first letters of
                firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone (display)
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the country
                code (with its leading '+'), a space, then the national digits
                grouped in threes (e.g. '+61412345678' becomes
                '+61 412 345 678'). Derived from the owner's own telephone; the
                raw 'telephone' field stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: >-
                The version of the owner identity contract this representation uses.
                Fixed at 2: the identifiers (memberId, identityKey, householdId) are
                grouped under the 'identity' object and derived with the version-2
                algorithm.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerIdentity'
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the owner's (business-day-adjusted) registrationDate,
                formatted 'FY<YY>'. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and is named by the
                calendar year in which it ends, so a date from 1 July 2025 to 30 June
                2026 yields 'FY26'. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners (before this owner was created) that
                shared the same firstName and lastName, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, fixed on creation. Starts at 0, adds 2
                when an email address is present, adds 1 when namesakeCount is 0, adds 2
                for a household of three or more members and adds 3 for tenure over one
                elapsed fiscal year. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, fixed on creation and derived from
                membershipPoints: level 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3 points, 3 for 4-5
                points and 4 for 6 or more points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner, though not a hard (identityKey) duplicate, was
                created while sharing an existing owner's lastName and postcode with a
                different telephone; false otherwise. Assigned on create.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner possibly duplicates (shared
                lastName and postcode, different telephone); the lowest-id match when
                several exist. Present only when possibleDuplicate is true.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is
                false; DELETE /api/owners/{id} flags it true while retaining the
                record, so the owner is still returned by GET but is ignored by the
                create endpoint's duplicate/identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality (region) taken from the REGION segment of the
                memberId identity ('<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>'), i.e. the region derived
                from the postcode (city-to-region table as fallback: Sydney->NSW,
                Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD). 'UNKNOWN' when no region resolves.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone name derived from the locality/region via
                the pinned region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the
                region has no mapped timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created on this
                owner's (business-day-adjusted) registration date at the time this
                owner was created, otherwise false. Assigned on create.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when the owner's city already held between 40 and 49 owners
                (inclusive) at the time this owner was created, signalling the city
                is approaching the hard capacity limit of 50; otherwise false.
                Assigned on create.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                True when the owner should be flagged for risk review: set when the
                owner is a possible duplicate, or the email domain is disposable-adjacent
                (shares a known throwaway provider's base name under a different TLD or as
                a subdomain), or the city is over its soft capacity (the capacity-warning
                threshold); otherwise false. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the owner's
                own fields: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise
                'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from the birthDate against the
                registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64,
                'SENIOR' at 65 or over. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is 'PREMIUM'
                when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is
                'METRO' when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD),
                otherwise 'REGIONAL'. One of 'PREMIUM_METRO', 'PREMIUM_REGIONAL',
                'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical API path to this owner, formatted '/api/owners/<id>'.
                Derived from the owner's own id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page

          minimum: 0

        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 1
          example: 5
        totalElements:
          title: Total elements
          description: Total number of pets matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0
          example: 10
        totalPages:
          title: Total pages
          description: Total number of pages matching the request.

    OwnerIdentity:
      title: Owner identity
      description: >-
        The owner's version-2 identifiers, grouped together. Each is derived with the
        version-2 algorithm that mixes in a fixed 'V2' version tag, so no value here
        matches one the same owner produced under version 1.
      type: object
      properties:
        memberId:
          title: Member ID
          description: >-
            The owner's unified member id formatted '<IDREGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' where
            IDREGION is the version-2 identity region code (the postcode-derived region
            prefixed with the fixed 'V2' version tag, e.g. 'V2NSW'), FY is the two-digit
            fiscal year of the (business-day-adjusted) registrationDate (the fiscal year
            starts on 1 July and is named by the calendar year in which it ends, so a date
            from 1 July 2025 to 30 June 2026 yields '26'), HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case
            hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized telephone concatenated with the
            lastName, and CHK is a single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits
            of '<IDREGION><FY><HASH8>'. Assigned on create (e.g. 'V2NSW261A2B3C4D7').
          type: string
          example: 'V2NSW261A2B3C4D7'
          readOnly: true
        householdId:
          title: Household ID
          description: >-
            A deterministic identifier shared by owners of the same household: the first
            12 hex characters of SHA-256 over the version-2 identity region, the normalized
            last name and the postcode. Assigned to every owner on create, so owners with
            the same last name and postcode return the same value automatically.
          type: string
          example: '3f9a2c1b8d4e'
          readOnly: true
        identityKey:
          title: Identity key
          description: >-
            The owner's derived duplicate-detection key: the lower-case hex SHA-256 over
            the version-2 identity region, the normalized E.164 telephone, the lower-cased
            email (empty when absent) and the Soundex code of the last name. Derived from
            the owner's own fields.
          type: string
          example: 'a3f9c1b8d4e2...'
          readOnly: true
      readOnly: true
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            Optional honorific title of the pet owner. When present it is one of
            MR, MRS, MS or DR. It is stored and returned, and the owner's
            salutation is composed from it with the last name.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: 'DR'
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            First line of the owner's structured postal address (street number and
            name). Preferred over the flat 'address' field when present; when present
            it must be non-blank. Normalized on create (trimmed, whitespace collapsed,
            upper-cased, common street-type abbreviations expanded) and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            Optional second line of the structured postal address (unit, suite, etc.).
            Normalized on create the same way as addressLine1 and, when present,
            appended to the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 5'
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted as a flat value for backward
            compatibility when the structured 'addressLine1' is not supplied. On create
            it is the composed, normalized address: equal to the normalized addressLine1
            with the normalized addressLine2 appended after a single space when present,
            or the normalized flat value when only the flat form was supplied. An owner
            must supply an address in either form (a non-blank addressLine1, or this
            flat field) plus a city.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            Optional 4-digit postcode. When present it must be a 4-digit value and,
            for a city with a known region (Sydney=NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne=VIC
            3000-3099, Brisbane=QLD 4000-4099), fall within that region's inclusive
            range; a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. It is
            stored and returned.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61' is
            assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits;
            there must be 8 to 15 digits after the '+'. The E.164 value is stored
            and returned (e.g. '0412 345 678' becomes '+61412345678').
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            Optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current
            date. It is stored and returned.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Create-time flag. The householdId is always deterministic from (last name,
            postcode), so this flag no longer creates the link. It only bypasses the
            duplicate block: a second owner in an existing household is rejected with 409
            unless it sets sharesHousehold true, in which case it is created as a declared
            household member and is not flagged as a possible duplicate. Not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: false
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            Optional date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. When
            present it is stored and returned, and the owner's ageBand is derived from
            it against the registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the
                stored names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation composed from the optional title and the
                last name: '<title> <lastName>' when a title is present, or just
                the last name when no title was supplied. Derived from the
                owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The owner's initials as the upper-cased first letters of
                firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone (display)
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the country
                code (with its leading '+'), a space, then the national digits
                grouped in threes (e.g. '+61412345678' becomes
                '+61 412 345 678'). Derived from the owner's own telephone; the
                raw 'telephone' field stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: >-
                The version of the owner identity contract this representation uses.
                Fixed at 2: the identifiers (memberId, identityKey, householdId) are
                grouped under the 'identity' object and derived with the version-2
                algorithm.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerIdentity'
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the owner's (business-day-adjusted) registrationDate,
                formatted 'FY<YY>'. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and is named by the
                calendar year in which it ends, so a date from 1 July 2025 to 30 June
                2026 yields 'FY26'. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners (before this owner was created) that
                shared the same firstName and lastName, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, fixed on creation. Starts at 0, adds 2
                when an email address is present, adds 1 when namesakeCount is 0, adds 2
                for a household of three or more members and adds 3 for tenure over one
                elapsed fiscal year. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, fixed on creation and derived from
                membershipPoints: level 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3 points, 3 for 4-5
                points and 4 for 6 or more points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner, though not a hard (identityKey) duplicate, was
                created while sharing an existing owner's lastName and postcode with a
                different telephone; false otherwise. Assigned on create.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner possibly duplicates (shared
                lastName and postcode, different telephone); the lowest-id match when
                several exist. Present only when possibleDuplicate is true.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is
                false; DELETE /api/owners/{id} flags it true while retaining the
                record, so the owner is still returned by GET but is ignored by the
                create endpoint's duplicate/identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality: the plain region code recovered from the memberId
                identity ('<IDREGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>') with the 'V2' identity version tag
                stripped, i.e. the region derived from the postcode (city-to-region table
                as fallback: Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD). This is never
                an identifier and never carries the 'V2' tag. 'UNKNOWN' when no region
                resolves.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone name derived from the locality/region via
                the pinned region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the
                region has no mapped timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created on this
                owner's (business-day-adjusted) registration date at the time this
                owner was created, otherwise false. Assigned on create.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when the owner's city already held between 40 and 49 owners
                (inclusive) at the time this owner was created, signalling the city
                is approaching the hard capacity limit of 50; otherwise false.
                Assigned on create.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                True when the owner should be flagged for risk review: set when the
                owner is a possible duplicate, or the email domain is disposable-adjacent
                (shares a known throwaway provider's base name under a different TLD or as
                a subdomain), or the city is over its soft capacity (the capacity-warning
                threshold); otherwise false. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the owner's
                own fields: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise
                'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from the birthDate against the
                registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64,
                'SENIOR' at 65 or over. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is 'PREMIUM'
                when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is
                'METRO' when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD),
                otherwise 'REGIONAL'. One of 'PREMIUM_METRO', 'PREMIUM_REGIONAL',
                'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical API path to this owner, formatted '/api/owners/<id>'.
                Derived from the owner's own id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page

        content:

        page:

          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 0
        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 1
          example: 5
        totalElements:
          title: Total elements
          description: Total number of pets matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0
          example: 10
        totalPages:
          title: Total pages
          description: Total number of pages matching the request.

    PetFields:
      title: Pet fields

    Pet:

## What I changed

**Version-2 region code (the core of the change)** — `OwnerRegion.java`:
- Added `IDENTITY_VERSION = "V2"` and `identityRegionOf(owner)` = `"V2" + regionOf(owner)` (e.g. `V2NSW`). This V2-tagged code is what goes *inside* the identifiers.
- `regionFromMemberId(...)` now strips the `V2` tag after stripping the trailing `<FY><HASH8><CHK>` segment, so the plain region (`NSW`) is recovered for user-facing use.

**Identifiers rederived** (each now mixes in the V2 region, so every value differs from v1 and no v1 value recurs):
- `AssignOwnerMemberId` — memberId is now `<V2REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>` (e.g. `V2NSW261A2B3C4D7`). Since v1 regions never start with `V2`, no v1 memberId is reproduced.
- `HouseholdKey` — canonical now `identityRegion|lastName|postcode`; household *membership* (`equals`/`matches`) still keys on last name + postcode only.
- `OwnerIdentity` — identityKey canonical now `identityRegion|telephone|email|soundex(lastName)`.

**User-facing fields stay plain** (`NSW`, never `V2…`): `locality`, `timezone`, and the owner segment all flow through `regionFromMemberId`, which strips the tag — and the segment is thereby "recomputed from the version-2 identity" (the v2 memberId) while keeping its region plain.

**Response shape** — `openapi.yml` + `OwnerMapper.java`:
- New nested `identity` object (`OwnerIdentity` schema → `OwnerIdentityDto`) holding `memberId`, `identityKey`, `householdId`; these three removed from the top level.
- New top-level integer `apiVersion` = 2.

**Audit schema v2** — `OwnerCreatedEvent.java`: added an intrinsic `schemaVersion` field stamped to `2` (4-arg constructor unchanged, so `AuditOwnerCreated` needed no change).

Request fields are untouched.
